title: Deferred capacity hedger and utilization snapshot sampler
author: Anjali Rao
description:
Motivation: We continue to see noisy decommits during low-but-bursty workload patterns that cause repeated warm-pool churn and SLA blips for Dedicated customers. This PR introduces two related pieces: (1) a Deferred Capacity Hedger controller that delays decommit decisions by applying a time-decayed utilization hedging factor, and (2) a low-cardinality Utilization Snapshot Sampler that produces representative per-pool utilization snapshots instead of high-cardinality per-tenant telemetry. Together these reduce unnecessary deallocations, lower warm-pool oscillation, and maintain SLA guarantees with reduced telemetry cost.

Design highlights: The hedger computes a per-pool "decommit_score" that combines recent weighted p95 utilization, the buffer of active reservations, and a decay-based runway estimator. Decommit is deferred if the score is below a configurable safety_threshold for a grace window. The sampler attaches a deterministic sampling key to requests and emits a single sampled utilization event per pool per sampling_window, producing a sliding-window sketch that downstream analytics can reconstruct into p50/p90/p95 approximations.

Rollout plan: feature flag default-off; staged rollout to a shadow mode for 2 weeks in 3 non-production clusters, then opt-in to soft-defer (no actual decommit) for a week in canary, before enabling hard-defer for a subset of Dedicated pools. We included throttles and an emergency disable flag wired to the operator console.

Backward compatibility and safety: Hedger is parameterized so default behavior is identical to current decommit path. Sampler is additive telemetry; no data required for correctness. We added circuit-breakers for memory pressure and ensured the hedger consults the existing reservation ledger to avoid violating active commitments.

Testing and metrics: Unit tests cover hedger scoring and sampler determinism. Integration tests simulate bursty traces and assert that churn reduces vs baseline. New metrics: hedger_defer_decisions_total, hedger_defer_duration_seconds, sampler_emitted_snapshots_total, sampler_reconstruction_error_estimate. Alerts: hedger_defer_ratio > 0.6 for >1h triggers investigation.

Why this is unique: Prior PRs focused on warm-pool sizing and direct smoothing. This PR couples a lightweight telemetry sampler with a time-aware decommit hedger to make decisions informed by representative utilization without increasing telemetry cardinality.

review_comments: Marco Diaz (reviewer): Can you expand on the math for the decay factor? In particular the choice of exponential vs linear decay and sensitivity to long idle tails?

Anjali Rao (author): Chose exponential with half-life configurable per-pool. Linear had poor responsiveness in our synthetic workloads; exponential gives bounded memory and intuitive weight falloff. Added comment + benchmark in hedger_test.go.
Evelyn Chen (reviewer): Sampler reduces cardinality, but how do we prevent sampling bias across tenants with highly skewed traffic?

Anjali Rao (author): Sampler uses deterministic per-tenant key + reservoir-style mapping to produce a uniform hash across tenants; also added post-aggregation bias estimate metric (sampler_reconstruction_error_estimate) so ops can quantify skew. Documented tradeoffs in docs/ops/hedger.md.
Jordan Kim (reviewer): e2e integration was flaky once — CI showed a timing-related failure on the harness. Please add retry/backoff in test harness to avoid nondeterministic failures.
Anjali Rao (author): Added backoff and a synthetic delay injection toggle in the test harness. Re-ran CI — green.
release_notes: Introduces Deferred Capacity Hedger (opt-in) and Utilization Snapshot Sampler. Operators can enable hedger to reduce decommit churn and lower telemetry volume with representative snapshots. New metrics added for monitoring defer decisions and sampler reconstruction error. Backward compatible by default.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'hedger.enabled' in the configmap to start shadow mode (no decommits). Monitor hedger_defer_ratio and sampler_reconstruction_error_estimate during rollout. Emergency disable available at /console/admin/feature-flags. Default half-life set to 1h; tune per-pool based on observed tail patterns.
